description: This file handles the module update process in the vtiger CRM application, including uploading module packages, validating, and managing versions.

classes.name: Vtiger_Package
classes.description: Represents a package containing a module or language files for updating Vtiger modules.

classes.name: Vtiger_Module
classes.description: Represents a module within vtiger CRM, providing access to module info and operations.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty class instance used for rendering templates in vtiger CRM

methods.name: getModuleNameFromZip
methods.description: Extracts module name from a given ZIP file.

methods.name: isLanguageType
methods.description: Checks if the package is a language type.

methods.name: getDependentVtigerVersion
methods.description: Returns the required Vtiger version for the package.

methods.name: getLicense
methods.description: Returns the license information of the package.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of the package.
